name: create_jira_ticket
description: Create a Jira issue for an IT problem that needs tracking or escalation. Use this when a user reports an issue (VPN, Wi-Fi, password/MFA, email, performance, printing, meetings, access, or software) that should be logged as a ticket, or when the user asks to raise a ticket. Returns the Jira issue key and URL.

summary.description: Short one-line summary of the issue.

description.description: Full details of the problem: symptoms, exact error, device/OS, and steps already tried.

issue_key.description: The created Jira issue key, e.g. KAN-2.
